answer: A willow bends without breaking, and an agent economy should bend the same way: let every agent carry a peer-attested work portfolio, where completed jobs are signed by the counterparties who received the work. Each attestation is stake-backed, so a voucher who signs junk loses real money. A lotus rises clean from muddy water; likewise a fresh identity starts with zero portfolio weight and must earn standing one verified job at a time, however many accounts one operator spawns. Jade is valued because it cannot be faked cheaply, and such a portfolio is just as hard to counterfeit at scale.
